snippet.title: Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk - Early Access Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Dive into the charming world of Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk, an idle simulation game where you create and manage your very own vending machine business. Set up machines in various city spots, transforming ordinary streets and alleys into bustling hotspots. Decorate each location with plants, lights, and themed items to attract more customers and increase sales. Hire and manage staff to keep your business running smoothly, assigning responsibilities like restocking, cleaning, and repairs. Whether you’re actively engaged or letting the game run passively in the background, your business continues to flourish while you enjoy a soothing soundtrack that’s perfect for multitasking.

Vending Dokan! offers a relaxing atmosphere with cozy visuals and calming ambiance sounds, making it an ideal companion during work, study, or other activities. Experience the joy of building and customizing your vending machine empire at your own pace.

For a hands-on experience, try the free demo, which offers unrestricted gameplay up to Milestone 5. Please note that this is a demo of Vending Dokan, which will release in Early Access, so you might experience bugs or some features might feel unfinished or unpolished. The developers are keen to hear your feedback about the demo, so feel free to share your thoughts on their Discord or Steam Forums.

Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk is developed by Aftabi Games and is available on Steam.
